name: Ahsan
site: telenor.com · Telecom for business customers, Norway
headline: Turn Telenor’s usage data into customers who stay.
saw: Your homepage speaks to business customers and shows promotions and discounts to every visitor the same way, whatever they already buy or use.
Usage signals (data volumes, roaming, top-ups, unused services) are your strongest guide to the next upgrade or cancellation. Today they sit in analytics, not in the message customers receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns for business accounts are built by hand, per segment, per month. A business customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Usage drops, unused services and support contacts flag which business customer is about to leave. Each one gets the offer, channel and moment that fits them, tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match the next service to each account
cases.text: Next best product and add-on per business customer, based on what they already use and what they never touch. No more blanket upgrade mails to accounts that have the service.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep business accounts using the service
cases.text: Personal nudges on usage, new features and service tips, sent in the channel each account responds to, so every business customer has a reason to use more each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
